news.headline: FTAI Aviation stock hits 52-week low at $149.47
news.summary: FTAI shares fell to a 52-week low of $149.47 days before Q3 results, after a brief 7-8% rebound on October 21 faded. The stock has lost roughly half its value from the $323 high amid aftermarket-sector selling and margin/power-business questions.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Names Howmet Its Top Aerospace Pick, Replacing FTAI; Cuts FTAI Target to $310
news.summary: Morgan Stanley swapped FTAI out as its top commercial-aerospace pick in favour of Howmet, arguing the aftermarket selloff is overdone, and lowered its FTAI target to $310 from $360 while keeping an Overweight rating. The bank remains constructive on FTAI, but losing top-pick status removes a prominent sell-side tailwind ahead of Q3.

news.headline: Macquarie Initiates FTAI Aviation at Outperform With $305 Price Target
news.summary: Macquarie analyst Marni Lysaght launched coverage at Outperform with a $305 target, about 80% above the then-price of roughly $169, as part of a six-name aerospace initiation. The shares had fallen about a third over six months.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Signs Multi-Year Engine Exchange Agreement With United Airlines, Extending the Program to CFM56-7B
news.summary: United expanded its maintenance, repair and exchange partnership with FTAI from the V2500 to CFM56-7B engines under a multi-year deal, receiving serviceable engines ahead of scheduled removals instead of shop visits. It is a marquee validation of FTAI's exchange model with a major U.S. carrier.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call
news.summary: FTAI will report Q3 2026 results on October 29 before market open with an 8:00 a.m. ET call. The stock rose about 8% that day as investors weighed the buyback, the WestJet 737 deal and the earnings setup.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation acquires 27 Boeing 737-700 aircraft from WestJet
news.summary: FTAI's 2026 SPV bought 17 WestJet-leased aircraft via sale-leaseback, and FTAI acquired the other 10 off lease for its Aerospace Products business.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Results before market open with an 8:00 a.m. ET call (announced October 6). Key items: Aerospace Products EBITDA and margins, module/engine exchange volumes including the new United CFM56-7B program, SPV deployment, and progress on the $500M buyback.

catalysts.label: Investor meeting in New York
catalysts.detail: Scheduled investor meeting; a likely venue for 2027 guidance and an update on the asset-light SPV strategy.

pulse: FTAI hit a 52-week low of $149.47 on October 23, roughly half its $323 high, as the aerospace-aftermarket selloff and questions on margins and the power business weigh on the shares; a 7-8% bounce on October 21 did not hold. Sell-side support remains (Macquarie initiated at Outperform/$305; Morgan Stanley Overweight but cut to $310 and dropped FTAI as top pick for Howmet). Q3 results on October 29 are the key near-term test, with business support from the United CFM56-7B exchange deal, the WestJet 737-700 purchase and the $500M buyback.
